invariants: No additional classifier, reviewer or quality-retry model turn on the default path.
Answer-only requests require neither a repository nor file changes.
Only observed evidence may substantiate completion.
Timing logs never contain prompt, answer or credential content.
Answer-only intent signals require directive syntax; nominal requests are recognized only in the task title or explicit user instruction, not source-document prose.
Messages that render empty, including empty editor HTML, are excluded before the recent-message budget; eligibility and prompt rendering use the same normalization.
Keyword intent classification is advisory only; every new assignment reaches the existing provider turn, preserving task context and explicit instruction without an extra model request.

loop.observation: Simple requests could stall on intent gates; failed first-event transitions could lose answer text; empty provider success could be presented as completion. Independent PR review reproduced ten rendered-empty editor HTML rows displacing an earlier user constraint before the eight-message budget.
loop.hypothesis: Single-turn guidance, buffered delivery and deterministic completion checks improve reliability without a new model call.
loop.execute: Run scoped regressions, full Go tests, race checks, a real one-turn Codex probe and before/after authenticated SSE measurements.
loop.evaluate: No extra turn/start on an answer-only task; recover failed delivery text; reject empty unverified results; report timing without a speedup claim from small samples. TestAcceptanceRenderedEmptyHistoryPreservesEarlierRequirement fails on the reviewed head and passes with shared readability normalization before selection.
loop.retrospective: Keep semantic quality distinct from deterministic evidence; retain existing opt-in continuations and recovery.

measurement.interpretation: Small unrandomized sample; observed medians increased; no speedup/no-regression claim. SSE receipt, not UI paint.
